{{Top|leg}}
'''White Team''' was a unit of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] operatives active in the [[Mortex sector/Legends|Mortex sector]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They were led by [[Untos Poquot]], with the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Worrumba]] as second in command. Two [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and two [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] completed the team. They were part of the Alliance force that [[Battle for Black Ice|captured]] the ''[[Black Ice/Legends|Black Ice]]'', but were [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the assault.
